model: …
Dictate hold to talk · double-tap to lock
Dictate + polish hold to talk; text goes through your polish command
Hands-free press to start, press again (or Dictate) to stop
Paste last transcript press to insert your last dictation again (also in the tray menu)
Holding Dictate and adding the extra key of another shortcut switches the running recording (e.g. Fn, then Space → hands-free).
Volume while recording: % of the current level

Shortcuts and the microphone apply immediately. Other settings take effect after restarting hearme.

Refreshes every 2 seconds. Details are also in ~/Library/Logs/hearme/hearme.log.

Examples: claude -p "…" · codex exec "…" · ollama run llama3.2 "…"
